title: Emerald AI, Google and NVIDIA Launch Alliance to Advance Flexible AI Data Centers
facebook: The AI tools you use could soon run smoother without stressing the power grid. A new group of tech giants is teaching data centers to dial their energy use up or down based on what's happening on the electric grid — so you keep getting the AI help you need without brownouts. https://aiworldhq.com/article/what-flexible-ai-data-centers-actually-means-for-you #AIEnergy #Tech
